criteria.description: A readable workbook contains every requested reconciliation sheet.
All ten ledger/subledger records use the correct transaction-date FX rate and USD normalization.
Only in-period invoice pairs are matched, with correct source amounts, approved adjustment, differences, and the $1 tolerance status.
The variance bridge and final decision close to the matched and unmatched records.
The workbook shows the transaction-date FX evidence used for normalization.
The approved ADJ-105 evidence is retained and applied to INV-105 before tolerance is assessed.
Ledger-only and subledger-only exceptions remain distinct with correct identities and amounts.
Every ledger, subledger, FX-rate, and adjustment-evidence source field is preserved exactly.
Checks expose the matched difference, exception count, and final closure residual in reviewable form.
